rows.role_title: Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: Announcements, Tablings and Committee Reports No 31 of Thursday 9 March 2023 reproduce the President's letter dated 08 March 2023 to the Speaker, advising that he has, under section 91(4) of the Constitution, appointed 'Mr Shipokosa Paulus Mashatile, the Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa, as the Leader of Government Business in the National Assembly'.

locator.section: Announcements, National Assembly, item 1 'Appointment of Leader of Government Business' (listed on pdf page 2; the letter is a scanned image on pdf page 3)

bounded_scope: Deputy President observations for CLAUDE-C01-21 only (role za_deputy_president in za_presidency). Announcements, stated intentions, appointments and their notices, oaths and their scheduling, stated assumptions, releases, resignations and their stated effect, Assembly-seat events and in-office attestations stay separate rows; holder observations and any start or end are decided in the packet, not by any row.
